title: Research: prove the mixed UT4 z/uz endpoint needs fourteen calls
body:
## Summary

Resolve PR #2027's first concrete mixed pure-central/noncentral handoff, in its full formal F2[UT4(F2)] rank-one alphabet:

```diff
 diag([z], [uz], identity on arbitrary restored dirty roles)
- known necessary bounds leave 12 <= unit calls <= 14
+ the unit minimum is exactly 14 for every finite role count
```

The new general middle bound is `n_b >= 2d+k`, where d counts active target roles and k counts pure-central roles. For z/uz, thirteen calls would force counts `(4,5,4)` and all six scalar spans to equal the active two-role plane. Extra dirty workspace therefore cannot help. A complete two-role quotient census excludes that split. The existing fourteen-call upper word is credited to its predecessors, not claimed as a new construction.

Only `research/ut4-mixed-central-middle/` is added. It contains the proof, exact checker, deterministic receipt, separate dense/literal tests, source pins, task metadata and opt-in replay. Scientific base is canonical main `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`, priority revision 4. The selected record and kappa are unchanged.

## Evidence

Before, PR2027's sharp family excluded pure-central roles and explicitly left z/uz open. After, the new checker covers 3,600 zero-sum middles, 9,721 outer profiles, 68 cross-compatible key pairs, 152 profile pairs and every one of 5,536 expanded thirteen-call words. Zero survive the complete necessary quotient. The retained upper witness passes its full formal endpoint and all 192 faithful basis columns, including dirty workspace.

Executed on CPython 3.12.15, standard library only:

```sh
python3.12 -I -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/ut4-mixed-central-middle
python3.12 -I -O -B -W error research/ut4-mixed-central-middle/verify.py
python3.12 -B -W error -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_*.py'
```

Registered and optimized replays pass, as do nine focused test groups and all 65 research-workflow tests. Controls include fifteen wrong endpoints, a mutated relaxation, invalid alphabet/rank, source and receipt drift, no-overwrite, planted independent word reconstruction and direct-versus-indexed joins. Minimal read-only source-export replay also passes without Git/network. The exact expansion digest is `118ea0c1edc09d94b02e90dce7a6bf6168f917b5d10f78a9d59ef77dd04703a8`.

The written span/compression argument supplies the arbitrary-workspace quantifier; finite fixtures alone do not. No Lean/kernel proof, weighted-tariff optimum, native/compiler realization, rational frames, physical hosting, precision/tape, selected cold replay or new multiplication exponent is claimed. Hosted CI status is separate from these local checks.

Credit Gareth Davidson/PR2027 for the mixed family and handoff; ToikY/PR1662 and PR1680 for the quotient and compression methods; Aaron Wang/PR1690 for profile screening; and the retained PR1573/1589/1607 lineage. Exact source blobs and SHA256 pins are in SOURCES.json. No predecessor executable is imported by the kept checker. Verification is author-checked, not independent human review.

Canonical coordination: https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/2019#discussioncomment-18934668 . Final reported overlap covers 418 open PRs and 850 Discussion records with complete pagination, but not all diffs or unpublished work. The scope change from native mechanism construction to this formal-model handoff is explicit in TASK.json.

## Merge danger

**Door:** two-way. The entire package can be removed without changing any selected or frozen source.

**Blast radius:** package. Its opt-in workflow adds one bounded standard-library replay. The result is scoped to the stated formal alphabet and unit tariff; it must not be promoted into a physical supplier claim.

Open next questions are weighted fourteen-call splits and a fully charged physical alphabet implementation. They are recorded with first steps and blockers in README.md and TASK.json.
